parameters.name: Add API Key for Higher Rate Limit
parameters.description: Enter your Jina API key to access a higher rate limit. For latest rate limit information, please refer to the table below.

parameters.name: Browser Engine (Quality/Speed)
parameters.description: Choose the browser engine for fetching the webpage content. This affects the quality, speed, completeness, accessibility of the content.

options.label: Default
options.description: Most compatible engine offering good balance between quality and speed.

options.label: Speed First
options.description: Fastest engine, optimized for speed but unable to handle JavaScript-generated dynamic content.

options.label: Best Quality
options.description: High-quality engine designed to resolve rendering issues and deliver the best content output.

options.label: Experimental
options.description: Fast engine capable of handling JavaScript-heavy websites we are experimenting with. Not recommended for production use. We may change its behavior.

parameters.name: Content Format
parameters.description: You can control the level of detail in the response to prevent over-filtering. The default pipeline is optimized for most websites and LLM input.

options.label: Default
options.description: The default pipeline optimized for most websites and LLM input.

options.label: Markdown
options.description: Returns the markdown directly from the HTML, bypassing the readability filtering.

options.label: HTML
options.description: Returns documentElement.outerHTML.

options.label: Text
options.description: Returns document.body.innerText.

options.label: Screenshot
options.description: Returns the image URL of the first screen.

options.label: Pageshot
options.description: Returns the image URL of full page screenshot (with best effort).

parameters.name: JSON Response
parameters.description: The response will be in JSON format, containing the URL, title, content, and timestamp (if available). In Search mode, it returns a list of five entries, each following the described JSON structure.

parameters.name: Timeout (seconds)
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait for page load. Increase for slow pages, decrease for simple static pages.

parameters.name: Token Budget
parameters.description: Limits the maximum number of tokens used for this request. Exceeding this limit will cause the request to fail.

parameters.name: Max Tokens
parameters.description: Allow up to N tokens in the response output. Increasing this value prevents content truncation for longer pages.

parameters.name: Use ReaderLM-v2
parameters.description: Uses ReaderLM-v2 for HTML to Markdown conversion, to deliver high-quality results for websites with complex structures and contents. Costs 3x tokens!

parameters.name: Extract Only (CSS Selector)
parameters.description: Only extract content matching these CSS selectors. Example: article, .main-content, #post-body

parameters.name: Wait For (CSS Selector)
parameters.description: Wait until these elements appear before extracting content. Useful for dynamically loaded content.

parameters.name: Exclude (CSS Selector)
parameters.description: Remove these elements before extraction. Example: nav, footer, .sidebar, #ads

parameters.name: Remove All Images
parameters.description: Strip all images from the output. Reduces token usage when images are not needed.

parameters.name: OpenAI Citation Format
parameters.description: Format links for OpenAI's web browsing tool. Uses special citation markers compatible with GPT models.

parameters.name: Links Summary Section
parameters.description: A "Buttons & Links" section will be created at the end. This helps the downstream LLMs or web agents navigating the page or take further actions.

options.label: None
options.description: Keep links inline.

options.label: Dedup
options.description: List unique links at the end.

options.label: All
options.description: List all links at the end.

parameters.name: Images Summary Section
parameters.description: An "Images" section will be created at the end. This gives the downstream LLMs an overview of all visuals on the page, which may improve reasoning.

options.label: None
options.description: Keep images inline.

options.label: Dedup
options.description: List unique images at the end.

options.label: All
options.description: List all images at the end.

parameters.name: Browser Viewport Size
parameters.description: Set browser window dimensions. Affects responsive layouts and content visibility.

parameters.name: Forward Cookie
parameters.description: Our API server can forward your custom cookie settings when accessing the URL, which is useful for pages requiring extra authentication. Note that requests with cookies will not be cached.

parameters.name: Image Caption
parameters.description: Captions all images at the specified URL, adding 'Image [idx]: [caption]' as an alt tag for those without one. This allows downstream LLMs to interact with the images in activities such as reasoning and summarizing.

parameters.name: Use a Proxy Server
parameters.description: Our API server can utilize your proxy to access URLs, which is helpful for pages accessible only through specific proxies.

parameters.name: Use a Country-Specific Proxy Server
parameters.description: Set country code for location-based proxy server. Use 'auto' for optimal selection or 'none' to disable.

parameters.name: Bypass Cached Content
parameters.description: Our API caches URL contents for a certain amount of time. Set it to true to ignore the cached result and fetch the content from the URL directly.

parameters.name: Cache Tolerance (seconds)
parameters.description: Accept cached content if younger than N seconds. Set to 0 for fresh content (same as Bypass Cache), or higher values to allow faster responses from cache.

parameters.name: Page Ready Timing
parameters.description: When to consider a page fully loaded. Later timings wait longer but capture more dynamic content.

options.label: Default
options.description: The default pipeline optimized for most websites and LLM input.

options.label: HTML Only
options.description: Returns documentElement.outerHTML.

options.label: Visible Content
options.description: reader.demo.headers.visible-content_explain

options.label: DOM Stable
options.description: reader.demo.headers.mutation-idle_explain

options.label: Resources Loaded
options.description: reader.demo.headers.resource-idle_explain

options.label: Media Loaded
options.description: reader.demo.headers.media-idle_explain

options.label: Network Idle
options.description: reader.demo.headers.network-idle_explain

parameters.name: Custom User-Agent
parameters.description: Override the browser User-Agent string. Useful for accessing sites that require specific browsers or block crawlers.

parameters.name: Custom Referer
parameters.description: Set the HTTP Referer header. Some sites check this to verify traffic comes from expected sources.

parameters.name: Preserve Base64 Images
parameters.description: Keep inline base64-encoded images in markdown output instead of converting them to external URLs.

parameters.name: Do Not Cache or Track
parameters.description: Prevent this request from being cached or logged on our servers. Use for sensitive URLs.

parameters.name: Github Flavored Markdown
parameters.description: Opt in/out features from GFM (Github Flavored Markdown).

options.label: Enabled
options.description: GFM (Github Flavored Markdown) features enabled.

options.label: Disabled
options.description: GFM (Github Flavored Markdown) features disabled.

options.label: No GFM Table
options.description: Opt out GFM Table but keep the table HTML elements in response.

parameters.name: Stream Mode
parameters.description: Stream mode is beneficial for large target pages, allowing more time for the page to fully render. If standard mode results in incomplete content, consider using Stream mode.

parameters.name: Customize Browser Locale
parameters.description: Control the browser locale to render the page. Lots of websites serve different content based on the locale.

parameters.name: Respect robots.txt
parameters.description: Check robots.txt rules before fetching. Specify which bot name to use for the check.

parameters.name: Include iframe Content
parameters.description: Extract content from embedded iframes. Enable for pages with content loaded in iframes.

parameters.name: Include Shadow DOM
parameters.description: Extract content from Shadow DOM components. Enable for pages using web components.

parameters.name: Use Final URL as Base
parameters.description: Resolve relative URLs using the final destination URL after redirects, instead of the original URL.

parameters.name: Local PDF/HTML file
parameters.description: Use Reader on your local PDF and HTML file by uploading them. Only support pdf and html files. For HTML, please also specify a reference URL for better parsing related CSS/JS scripts.

parameters.name: Run JavaScript Before Extraction
parameters.description: Execute custom JS to modify the page before content extraction. Can be inline code or a URL to a script file.

parameters.name: Heading Style
parameters.description: Sets markdown heading format (passed to Turndown).

options.label: Underline Style
options.description: Uses === or --- underlines below heading text (H1/H2 only).

options.label: Hash Style
options.description: Uses # symbols before heading text (# H1, ## H2, etc.).

parameters.name: Horizontal Rule Style
parameters.description: Defines markdown horizontal rule format (passed to Turndown).

parameters.name: Bullet Point Style
parameters.description: Sets bullet list marker character (passed to Turndown).

parameters.name: Emphasis Style
parameters.description: Defines markdown emphasis delimiter (passed to Turndown).

parameters.name: Strong Emphasis Style
parameters.description: Sets markdown strong emphasis delimiter (passed to Turndown).

parameters.name: Link Style
parameters.description: Determines markdown link format (passed to Turndown).

options.label: Inline
options.description: Links embedded directly within the text.

options.label: Reference
options.description: Links listed at the end, referenced by numbers in the text.

options.label: Plain Text
options.description: Links replaced with their anchor text.

parameters.name: EU Residency
parameters.description: When enabled, infrastructure and data processing for this request are located within the EU.
